$comment: Houdini Atlas — Scatter Surface Language starter pack node plan. Build by hand inside a Geometry SOP.

nodes.name: sphere
nodes.rationale: Predictable polygon sphere so prim count is reproducible across learners.

nodes.name: mountain
nodes.rationale: Adds organic relief without time dependence.

nodes.name: wr_recompute_N
nodes.rationale: Mountain leaves @N stale at high amplitude. Recompute before scatter.

nodes.name: wr_density_mask
nodes.rationale: Class MUST be point. The bug this module fixes is feeding a primitive-class mask to Scatter.

nodes.name: wr_visualise_mask
nodes.rationale: Cheap visualisation so the viewport tells the truth before Scatter runs.

nodes.name: scatter
nodes.rationale: Reads the point-class density attribute. Total count is forced so reproducibility is the contract, not a side-effect.

nodes.name: wr_scatter_inspect
nodes.rationale: Per-point neighbour count + local density estimate, so the spreadsheet PROVES the mask drove density.

wr_density_mask_attribs_prims: NO @density_mask HERE — that is the failure mode

honesty: Scatter parameter names differ across versions; verify before pasting the build plan. The bug this module fixes is class confusion, not a fancy aesthetic.
